southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:7ffc65.title: Web Designer
southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:7ffc65.description: Profound is the marketing platform for the age of AI search. The way brands reach people is being rewritten — AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode are now the answer layer between companies and their customers. We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage. We went from 0 to a $1B valuation in 18 months. Revenue grew 100x last year. Our customers include 15% of the Fortune 500 like Walmart, Wayfair and U.S. Bank, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. We are backed by Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, LSVP, and Khosla Ventures — and we are moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook everyone who comes after them will run. Design is foundational to our product and our company. As a Web Designer at Profound, you'll shape how the world experiences our brand online, from our marketing site to campaign landing pages to the surfaces where product meets story. You'll work closely with front-end engineers, design engineers, and the brand team to turn ideas into shipped, high-craft web experiences, with deep ownership over how Profound looks and feels on the web. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design and ship marketing pages, landing pages, and campaign sites that reflect Profound's dark, editorial, precise brand - Partner closely with front-end and design engineers to take work from concept to production, staying involved through build, QA, and launch - Design with real components and constraints in mind, working within (and helping evolve) our web design system - Prototype interactions and page-level motion, handing off specs and details that hold up in code - Own web design end to end for key initiatives, from homepage updates to launch pages for new product features - Collaborate with brand and product marketing to translate briefs into high-conversion, on-brand web experiences - Continuously audit and refine our existing site for craft and consistency - Occasionally extend into email, social, and event assets when the work connects to a web campaign WHO YOU ARE - You work with full autonomy and can take a brief and own it end to end, from concept to shipped page, without hand-holding - You have real command of web design fundamentals: layout, type, grid, hierarchy, and how they translate into code - You have a portfolio that shows a high bar for craft on real, shipped websites - You're fluent in Figma and AI tools, comfortable working close to the metal with front-end and design engineers; bonus for hands-on HTML/CSS or experience in a component-based design system - You sweat the finish (typography, spacing, rhythm, and consistency) and know what separates a good page from a great one - You move fast and reliably deliver high-quality work on short timelines without sacrificing craft - You're a versatile generalist, equally comfortable on a marketing landing page and a product-adjacent surface - You like to experiment and build with AI and new tools to work faster and push your craft further - You're a strong communicator who can articulate creative decisions and incorporate feedback to continuously improve the work - You can just do things NOTE FROM OUR CO-FOUNDER In the evolving landscape of product development, exceptional design is not merely a nice-to-have, it is foundational. As software engineering becomes increasingly accessible, it is taste, creativity, and thoughtful execution that differentiate outstanding products from the rest. I believe deeply that design sits at the core of our success. At Profound, my goal is to build a design team renowned for setting a new standard of excellence, crafting experiences so compelling they become benchmarks in our industry. If you are someone who believes in the transformative power of great design and wants to create work that genuinely shapes the future, join us. Let's redefine what's possible together.

southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:eb4071.description: Profound is the marketing platform for the age of AI search. The way brands reach people is being rewritten — AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode are now the answer layer between companies and their customers. We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage. We went from 0 to a $1B valuation in 18 months. Revenue grew 100x last year. Our customers include 15% of the Fortune 500 like Walmart, Wayfair and U.S. Bank, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. We are backed by Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, LSVP, and Khosla Ventures — and we are moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook everyone who comes after them will run. As a GTM Engineer focused on Pre-Sales and Outbound, you will build the infrastructure that powers every stage of our revenue pipeline. Part lead intelligence system and part outbound engine, you will capture every signal a prospect sends, qualify leads with precision, and make sure the right opportunity reaches the right rep at the right time. Your work will directly shape how our Sales function scales. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Scope and map every path a prospect can take into Profound’s funnel, then build systems that capture, qualify, and route each one without manual intervention - Build intent scoring models that rank leads by genuine buying signal rather than raw activity volume, so reps spend their time on the accounts most likely to convert - Design automated routing logic across territory, company size, and rep capacity, handling edge cases cleanly so the system holds up on the hard days, not just the easy ones - Produce rep-ready outputs directly from the scoring pipeline, so reps start their day dialing rather than cleaning spreadsheets - Build outbound sequence automation that generates personalized messaging at scale, drawing on firmographic and behavioral data - Own the full technical stack across the pipeline, from data ingestion and enrichment through scoring, routing, and delivery, and design schemas that make the whole system maintainable as it grows - Experiment relentlessly with new platforms, APIs, and AI-native tools, staying ahead of what is possible in the ecosystem WHO YOU ARE - High-agency builder who can scope a messy, multi-source data problem, design a system to solve it, and ship something a sales team will actually trust and use - Technically fluent in Python or JavaScript, comfortable building automated pipelines, integrating APIs, and working across the full data stack - AI-native thinker who defaults to automation and experiments regularly with agents, MCP, and workflow frameworks - Pragmatic about build versus buy, knowing when to assemble from existing tools rather than build from scratch - Familiar with tools like Clay, Orum, Apollo, PhantomBuster, n8n, or similar sales and automation platforms - Experience with GTM workflows such as sales operations, revenue operations, or a technical role inside a sales organization - You have spent meaningful time inside a revenue organization and built things that people on the floor actually relied on, not as an observer but as a practitioner - Systems thinker who considers edge cases and failure modes from the start, not as an afterthought - Comfortable operating in ambiguity and structuring your own roadmap LOCATION This is an on-site role based in our Union Square, NYC office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact. Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. southparkcommons-town:ashbyhq:1b2c9e27-c.title: Founding GTM Recruiter
southparkcommons-town:ashbyhq:1b2c9e27-c.description: ABOUT TOWN Town is an applied AI company building a powerful assistant that makes it easy for anyone to create and use software in their everyday work. Town starts from who you are — it builds a persistent model of your voice, judgment, relationships, and priorities, and does real work on your behalf across email, calendar, docs, Slack, and CRM. It doesn't wait to be prompted: it observes, learns, and acts. Town was founded by Jean-Denis Greze (CEO), former CTO of Plaid, and Tony Vincent (CPO), former Director of Applied AI Product at Google. We recently raised a $55M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from Forerunner Ventures, First Round Capital, Alt Capital, and Conviction. We're in-person in San Francisco's Financial District, five days a week. ABOUT THE ROLE Town is a true product-led-growth company. People find Town, start using it themselves, and bring their teams and companies with them — so we already have real enterprise usage and more inbound than we can keep up with. That groundswell is now turning into a go-to-market motion, and we've made our first commercial hires. What we need next is the person who builds the team behind the revenue: the recruiter who helps us hire our sales, marketing, and operations org from the ground up. You'll partner closely with the founders, the Head of Business, and other leaders across the company to personally carry our most important commercial searches, and to build the machine underneath them so a small team can hire like a much larger one. WHAT YOU'LL OWN - Run full-cycle GTM recruiting. From sourcing to closing and everything in between, across revenue and sales, product marketing, growth, business operations, customer success, and partnerships. - The candidate experience. High-touch, swift, thoughtful, and human at every touchpoint. You're often an individual's first touchpoint with Town, and you know how important candidate experience is to building an exceptional company & culture. - Helping build the systems. The GTM function is still early, and our founders and business leaders know what good looks like. You'll help build and maintain the infrastructure that allows us to move fast, get high signal, recognize patterns and improve how we do things. - Recruit for Town on Town. You'll get to know and leverage our product intimately to make sourcing, outreach, and coordination dramatically more efficient. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU... - Have 4+ years of full-cycle GTM recruiting experience, with a track record hiring commercial talent (sales, marketing, operations), ideally at a high-growth start-up - Get joy across the recruiting lifecycle. You know what it takes to build strong top of funnel, and you enjoy building the relationships that get the toughest closes over the line. - Know enough to be dangerous when conversing with top commercial talent. You can hold a credible conversation about what a great AE, marketer, or operator actually does, and tell signal from noise on a resume. - Operate with high agency. You find the work and own the outcome. You decide at 70%, not 90%, and correct as you go. - Write exceptionally well and represent Town with warmth and precision to every candidate. - Are AI-curious at a minimum. You've experimented with how AI can make you a better recruiter, and want to use AI to make yourself more effective. - Get energy from working with people in person. We're 5x per week at our office in SF. LOCATION San Francisco, CA — five days a week in-person at our Financial District office (222 Kearny St, near the Montgomery BART stop).
